items.exampleEn: We eat dinner at the table.
There is a clock on the wall.
The cat is on the floor.
I go to bed at eleven.
The toys are in the box.
Can I have a glass of water?

items.sentenceEn: The box is under the bed.

items.audioEn: The cat is not on the bed. It is under the table.
items.audioZh: 貓不在床上，牠在桌子底下。
options: On the chair by the door

items.sentenceEn: There are four chairs around the table.
Please put the box on the floor.

items.stemEn: I drink a ____ of milk every morning.
items.stemZh: 我每天早上喝一杯牛奶。

items.stemEn: It is hot. Can you open the ____?
items.stemZh: 好熱，你可以開一下窗戶嗎？

items.passageEn: This is my room. It has a big window, so it is very bright. My bed is by the window. There is a small table and one chair. On the wall, there is a picture of my family. Under the bed, there is a box of old toys.
items.passageZh: 這是我的房間。房間有一扇大窗戶，所以很明亮。我的床在窗戶旁邊。房間裡有一張小桌子和一張椅子。牆上有一張我家人的照片。床底下有一箱舊玩具。

referenceEn: Please put the glass on the table.
Put the glass on the table, please.
rubricZh: 「放在⋯上」可用 put … on 等（例如 put the glass on the table）
please 放句首或句尾都可以

items.instructionZh: 用 window 造一個句子，說說你房間或辦公室的窗戶。
referenceEn: My room has a big window.
I can see a park from my window.
rubricZh: window 前面加冠詞或所有格（例如 a big window、my window）
動詞配合主詞（例如 My room has、I can see）
